big_topics.name: 1. Protein complexes as functional and disease units

small_topics.name: complexes as molecular machines
small_topics.one_line: Most cellular functions, incl. OXPHOS and metabolism, are executed by stable multi-subunit assemblies

small_topics.name: guilt-by-association / shared phenotypes
small_topics.one_line: Subunits of one complex share phenotypes; complex membership links biochemistry to disease

small_topics.name: disease enrichment in complex subunits
small_topics.one_line: Complex subunits are strongly enriched for OMIM/clinical pathology (p<=1e-46)

small_topics.name: rare-variant convergence on complexes
small_topics.one_line: Rare variants in many genes converge on few complexes, so analysis should be complex-level

small_topics.name: collateral subunit loss
small_topics.one_line: Losing one subunit alters levels of other subunits and complex capacity

small_topics.name: complex dysfunction, not single proteins
small_topics.one_line: Disease often reflects deregulated complexes (spliceosome, proteasome, TOM/TIM)

small_topics.name: metabolons and moonlighting enzymes
small_topics.one_line: Metabolic enzymes form metabolons/super-complexes that channel flux; promiscuous complex members are enriched for metabolism

big_topics.name: 2. Inborn errors of metabolism (IEMs) and mitochondrial disease

small_topics.name: pathway-based IEM definition
small_topics.one_line: An IEM is any condition where disruption of a metabolic pathway is intrinsic to pathophysiology

small_topics.name: scale of IEMs
small_topics.one_line: 1015 IEMs in 130 groups; mitochondrial disorders largest (232, 22.9%)

small_topics.name: gene-product entries / genetic heterogeneity
small_topics.one_line: Leigh syndrome and MELAS each arise from many nuclear/mtDNA genes

small_topics.name: multifunctional complexes in IEMs
small_topics.one_line: SDH spans Krebs cycle and respiratory chain; same protein can give distinct disorders

small_topics.name: classification and diagnostic gaps
small_topics.one_line: 76% of metabolic disorders lack ICD-10 codes; SSIEM not updated since 2012

small_topics.name: gene panels and diagnostics
small_topics.one_line: Grouping by molecular aetiology guides sequencing panels and differential diagnosis

small_topics.name: BNE-based complexome profiling
small_topics.one_line: Blue-native gel + MS works on patient tissue, kDa–10 MDa; ~1 week for patient + controls

small_topics.name: assembly factor discovery (TMEM126B)
small_topics.one_line: CP identified TMEM126B as complex I assembly factor in MCIA; patients later characterised

small_topics.name: complex I assembly pathway
small_topics.one_line: CP time courses resolved the complete stepwise assembly of human complex I

small_topics.name: CP as standard diagnostic tool
small_topics.one_line: CP routinely reveals accumulated assembly intermediates in patients

small_topics.name: repair and turnover defects
small_topics.one_line: DNAJC30-LHON shows impaired complex I repair, not assembly

small_topics.name: Barth syndrome remodelling
small_topics.one_line: COPAL alignment revealed widespread mitochondrial complex remodelling

small_topics.name: metabolons and conditional remodelling
small_topics.one_line: Hypoxia degrades TMEM126B; plant TCA metabolons quantified by CN-PAGE

small_topics.name: limits of AP-MS, Y2H, proximity labelling
small_topics.one_line: Tagging/overexpression artefacts, binary-only readout, cannot resolve assembly states

small_topics.name: co-fractionation MS principle
small_topics.one_line: Native separation + MS; co-elution infers complexes without tags

small_topics.name: throughput barrier and short-gradient DIA
small_topics.one_line: Multi-condition CF-MS took weeks; SEC-SWATH with 21-min gradients cut this ~10-fold

small_topics.name: multiplexing (SILAC/TMT)
small_topics.one_line: Up to 18-plex enables multi-condition/patient comparisons

small_topics.name: mitochondrial complexes by crosslinked CF-MS
small_topics.one_line: Mouse brain: 20,742 PPIs / 543 mitochondrial complexes

small_topics.name: analysis tools
small_topics.one_line: EPIC, PrInCE, CCprofiler, SECAT, PCprophet, NOVA, ComplexFinder

big_topics.name: 5. Human complex atlases and reference resources

small_topics.name: incomplete human complexome
small_topics.one_line: hu.MAP2.0 covers 15–37% of predicted interactome; <1/5 ORFs annotated in 2012

small_topics.name: integrated atlases (hu.MAP 2.0/3.0)
small_topics.one_line: hu.MAP3.0: 15,326 complexes, ~70% of proteome, from >25,000 experiments

small_topics.name: curated resources
small_topics.one_line: CORUM 5204 complexes (~26% genes); Complex Portal >2150 human; Reactome, GO

small_topics.name: uncharacterized proteins
small_topics.one_line: 472 uncharacterized proteins annotated via co-complex membership

small_topics.name: disease gene candidates from complex maps
small_topics.one_line: IER3IP1–TMEM167A (MEDS), DIPK2B–NDST (heparan sulfate), RAD21 in CdLS, CORUM-OMIM linkage

small_topics.name: context-specific blind spots
small_topics.one_line: Atlases pool cell types; mutually exclusive paralog subunits and tissue-specific variants unresolved

big_topics.name: 6. Inferring complex remodelling from whole-proteome data

small_topics.name: fast deep proteomics
small_topics.one_line: Orbitrap Astral: ~10,000 proteins in <1 h; 180 samples/day; covers ~80% CORUM cores

small_topics.name: mitochondrial KO proteomes
small_topics.one_line: One-hour proteome applied to MGME1 KO from mitochondrial multiomics resource

small_topics.name: subunit co-variation as complex readout
small_topics.one_line: Strongly covarying proteins are co-complex; proteome beats transcriptome

small_topics.name: ComplexBrowser complex-level quantification
small_topics.one_line: OXPHOS complexes I/IV/V down in colon cancer (CFC −4.4)

small_topics.name: AlteredPQR stoichiometry shifts
small_topics.one_line: Altered protein-pair ratios reveal remodelling beyond single-protein abundance (79% non-overlap)

small_topics.name: database-dependence limitation
small_topics.one_line: Results depend on curated complexes; CORUM/Complex Portal overlap only 16%
